files.claim: Linearity preserves the two weights and their addition while time invariance reuses one impulse response at the required shift, producing [1,2.5,1.25,0.5].
files.inspection: The first pass exposed a decomposition connector crossing column headings; it was replaced by one concise downward cue. Final light/dark previews have no clipping or collisions, and dedicated 320 px previews preserve both weighted terms, both response ledgers, and the assembled output.

files.claim: At 8 kHz, dry, 400-sample/50-ms, and 960-sample/120-ms paths form three shifted copies on a proportional linear axis without circular wrap.
files.inspection: The first pass exposed an early-echo label collision and input-line overlap; the second exposed a clipped no-wrap takeaway. After spacing and canvas corrections, both themes show all gains, units, delays, sum flow, and proportional axis with no defects.
